parsed.rationale: One of the two `MetricRow` type-alias-object declarations lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under an `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp` path — a clear sample-app context. The other lives in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift` in the `DebugPanel` package. The sample-app copy is almost certainly a local convenience replica intentionally kept self-contained so the example target does not need to import `DebugPanel` as a dependency. Consolidating it would couple the sample app to the production debug panel package, which is typically undesirable for standalone examples.
